decisions.reason: The same source message already fully establishes external delivery of tutorial and graphic-heavy content for this Requirement; no additional or corrected Event is needed.

The client applies remote hosting to tutorial and graphic-heavy assets instead of bundling them in the app package, and the same-message content-delivery state applies to both Android and iOS, necessarily adding this size-reduction strategy to Android.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: i think like the tutorials and graphic heavy images we can upload onto my host so it isnt in the package to make it smaller

value_updates.remote_asset_hosting_strategy: Host heavy tutorial and graphic images remotely rather than include them in the application package.

decisions.reason: Remote hosting of heavy tutorial and graphic assets changes package-size and content-delivery behavior but does not alter localization coverage or RTL support.
Remote hosting of heavy tutorial and graphic assets does not change the Android localization workflow.
